HackNation 2026 · AED Mission – Data to the Rescue

Every minute counts

We bring scattered data on AED defibrillators together into one open, up-to-date dataset on dane.gov.pl, so that anyone can find the nearest available device in seconds.

  • Find the nearest AEDA map with opening hours and whether the device is accessible.
  • Share your dataAED owners add and update devices in one form or by importing a file.
  • Open data on dane.gov.plA verified dataset in CSV and GeoJSON, with the source and verification date of every record.
Open the prototype soon

Do you hold AED data? Join the campaign

Share the data. Give someone a chance.

Every AED owner can help. Just show where the AED is.

Problem

In sudden cardiac arrest every minute counts, and anyone can use an AED. But you need to know where the nearest one is, whether it is accessible and whether it works.

  • Scattered

    Several databases, each kept separately and in its own format.

  • Incomplete

    Opening hours, contacts and whether the AED is locked are often missing.

  • Unverified

    It is unclear who last checked a device's data, and when.
